text: Prioritize accidental abstraction removal before advanced acceleration. GC profiling showed copy allocation at 1.338 MB for a 0.262 MB result and 2.648 MB for a 0.524 MB result, confirming per-element boxing; contiguous add allocated only about 2.8 KB above its 0.524 MB result, so its gap is traversal rather than allocation; full sum allocated 4.165 KB, essentially its required pairwise scratch. LoopPlan.kind is already computed but unused by ElementKernels. Defer plan caching, scratch pooling, manual unrolling, Vector API, native backends, parallelism, and a fast reduction policy until direct monomorphic loops meet or miss their lower-bound targets.
